regions.merged_text: Shame Michelangelo on such a masterpiece. No doubt you were a genius in your hobby and did much to be admired. I would like to hope you were wont to receive the Holy Sacraments more appreciatively than not a few of our genius those these days. I pray that you are in Heaven and if not, that you may soon be there. Wherever or whatever any of us be, it seems to me the least we ought to do for such a work, notwithstanding its weaknesses, and for those - ought-tobe dear ones it reprisents - the least we could do, and which would possibly liberate the artist himself from Purgatory - would be to relieve their present worse than boorish appearance by presenting them each with an historical fig-leaf-apron. Believing in the dogma: "The Communion of Saints", such a move, I think though so simple in itself, would afford much relief to souls in Purgatory and annually to thousands of pilgrims and turists who otherwise would hardly care to return again to the otherwise famous Sistine Chapel.
